messages:
Anika Rao: hi all, first day here! I followed the observability onboarding and requested Datadog/Grafana/Sentry, but Grafana dashboards show 'No data' on panels and Datadog only shows my personal default view. Can someone point me to the minimal roles I need? :wave:
Devon K: welcome Anika :tada: For Grafana you need the org SSO group `infra-read` or `platform-view`. Datadog needs the role `dd-basic-read` + team dashboard shares. Sentry is per-project invite. Which team are you on?
Anika Rao: I'm on infra-tooling (lead: Devon). I used anika.rao@redwood.com for requests.
Jorge (SRE): quick check: if Grafana panels show 'No data' but you can see the dashboard skeleton, that's usually a Prometheus datasource permission or the dataspace filter. Try switching time range to 24h and click the datasource in panel to see errors. Also ensure the Grafana datasource alias matches cloud-prod.
Anika Rao: tried 24h, still empty. Error when I inspect panel: "Query returned 403: forbidden"
devex-bot: Datadog/Grafana/Sentry onboarding pointers: Datadog: grants@redwood-infra.com (include team + use-case), Grafana: IDP group infra-read for dashboards, Sentry: request via tickets.redwood.com -> Security -> Sentry Invite. Docs: https://docs.redwood.com/devex/observability/onboarding.
Devon K: @Jorge can you run the idp check for Anika? `idp check-user anika.rao@redwood.com` and `idp assign-group anika.rao@redwood.com infra-read` if missing.
Jorge (SRE): running checks... `idp check-user anika.rao@redwood.com` -> user exists. Group membership: missing infra-read. Assigning now. `idp assign-group anika.rao@redwood.com infra-read` -> queued, should apply in ~60s. Also pushed Datadog role dd-basic-read.
Anika Rao: reloading Grafana... dashboards populated now, thanks! Datadog dashboards showed up too. Sentry still says "project not found" on infra-tooling project list.
Devon K: Sentry: I'll send invite to infra-tooling projects (infra-core, infra-logging). If you need broader read, we can request security to add cross-project viewer role but that requires justification.
Devon K: sent invites for infra-core and infra-logging. Watch for email or SSO prompt.
Anika Rao: invite appeared, accepted, I can see errors and events. All access looks good now. Thank you everyone!
Anika Rao: one last: is there a short-runbook for common dashboard links and where to find runbooks for paging? I found some but a bit scattered.
Devon K: canonical runbook is linked from the onboarding doc and pinned in #devex: https://docs.redwood.com/devex/observability/runbooks. Also bookmark Grafana favorites: infra/live-overview, infra/latency-sla, infra/costing.
Jorge (SRE): if you want, I can add you to the Grafana dashboard editors group for small tweaks, ping me once you're comfortable.
Anika Rao: will do later. tagging this thread for future new hires. :white_check_mark:
